Based on its current operating plan, the Company believes its cash position is sufficient to support the advancement of its portfolio through multiple anticipated clinical and strategic milestones, including givastomig’s planned Phase 3 interim data read-out in 2028.
Givastomig is being evaluated in a global, randomized Phase 2 study (NCT07432295), following positive topline results from a Phase 1b, multicenter, open-label study in first-line gastric cancer.
